configurations.description: Planning and execution with the goal as written: no recall, no workflows, durable state, full prompt, the provider profile's structured output.
The goal plus the task's pre-written pointer to the relevant area (never the fix).
The goal plus the failing tests the harness observed before the work (a diagnosis-only intervention).
Episodic recall of verified earlier work.
Controlled workflow execution of an eligible candidate, recall off.
The compact wording of the decision contract.
A permissive structured-output mode (any JSON object) instead of the profile's schema.
Compact prompt with the permissive structured-output mode.
No durable state: an interrupted work can only be started again.
